research_scope: Three reviewed ordinary ideal-product/power aliases and one new R/I^n quotient ring alias into an existing separately tracked ring quotient. Do not merge nonunital positive-power legacy occurrence or module product.

aliases.reason: All four observed expressions invoke the operation of multiplying ideals by finite sums of elementwise products in a commutative unital ring. Ordinary powers are iterated ideal products, with the Rees and symbolic-power sources separately recording I^0=R. The stronger symbolic-power construction p^(n) is distinct and is not being aliased; neither is the induced submodule (I^n)M. Specifically source phrase 'powers I^n and ideal products' denotes the same product/power prerequisite.
